cues.text: Click AI Study Helper in the sidebar. It is a tutor that knows your class and subjects.
Click one of the suggestions to ask it right away.
Or type your own question in the box and press Enter. Shift and Enter start a new line.
You can send up to 30 messages a day. Your chat is saved, so you can come back to it later.
Click Clear Chat to delete the conversation and start again.
